title: LifelongCrossNav: Persistent 3D Semantic Memory for Cross-Floor Multi-Object Navigation
abstract: arXiv:2608.07079v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Object-goal navigation has made substantial progress in semantic perception and exploration, yet persistent memory for multi-object navigation and cross-floor navigation are still commonly addressed separately. We present LifelongCrossNav, a framework for sequential multi-object ObjectNav in unknown multi-floor indoor environments. Within each episode, the agent receives an ordered sequence of object-goal queries while continuously maintaining a shared sparse 3D semantic voxel memory. This memory incrementally accumulates geometric structure, traversability states, and vision-language features, allowing subsequent object-goal queries to retrieve previously acquired scene information without rebuilding the map. To support persistent search across floors, LifelongCrossNav combines support-aware 3D traversability mapping, stair-specific perception, and direction-aware stair traversal. translated_title: LifelongCrossNav：面向跨楼层多目标导航的持久性3D语义记忆
translated_abstract: 目标导航在语义感知与探索方面已取得长足进步，但面向多目标导航的持久记忆与跨楼层导航通常仍被分开处理。我们提出了LifelongCrossNav，一个面向未知多楼层室内环境中顺序式多目标ObjectNav的框架。在每个回合内，智能体接收按序排列的多个目标查询，同时持续维护一个共享的稀疏3D语义体素记忆。该记忆以增量方式积累几何结构、可通行状态以及视觉-语言特征，使后续的目标查询能够检索先前获取的场景信息，而无需重新构建地图。为支持跨楼层的持久搜索，LifelongCrossNav结合了考虑支撑面的3D可通行性建图、楼梯专用感知以及方向感知的楼梯通行。统一的导航策略协调同层……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出LifelongCrossNav框架，通过持续维护可复用的稀疏3D语义体素记忆并结合楼梯感知与跨层通行策略，实现了未知多楼层室内环境中的跨楼层顺序多目标导航。
en_tdlr: LifelongCrossNav maintains a persistent, reusable sparse 3D semantic voxel memory with stair-specific perception and traversal strategies, enabling cross-floor sequential multi-object navigation in unknown multi-floor indoor environments.
